an4.128:1.1: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā pātubhavanti.
an4.128:1.4: sā tathāgatena anālaye dhamme desiyamāne sussūsati. sotaṃ odahati. aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti.
an4.128:1.5: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati.
an4.128:2.2: sā tathāgatena mānavinaye dhamme desiyamāne sussūsati. sotaṃ odahati. aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti.
an4.128:2.3: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati.
an4.128:3.2: sā tathāgatena opasamike dhamme desiyamāne sussūsati. sotaṃ odahati. aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti.
an4.128:3.3: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ tatiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati.
an4.128:4.2: sā tathāgatena avijjāvinaye dhamme desiyamāne sussūsati. sotaṃ odahati. aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti.
an4.128:4.3: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ayaṃ catuttho acchariyo abbhuto dhammo pātubhavati.
an4.128:4.4: tathāgatassa bhikkhave arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā ime cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā pātubhavantīti.
